Make the meme whole.

  1. Meet your meme. Generate a random image and study it for five seconds.
  2. Let it scramble. The pieces shuffle when the preview ends.
  3. Swap any two pieces. Tap one, then another. Or drag and drop. Pieces can move anywhere.
  4. Take a peek. The small original image is always there as your guide.
  5. Get a little help. Tap “A little hint” or press H. After 30 seconds without progress, a hint appears automatically. The gold piece belongs in the blue slot.

Keyboard: Tab to a piece, Enter or Space to select it, then select another. Arrow keys move between pieces. Escape clears your selection.
